the effects of androgens on the cytochrome system of rat adrenal cortical mitochondira.
the effect of high doses of androgens on adrenal mitochondrial cytochromes and their interaction with adrenal mitochondria.
the effects of androgen on the adrenal mitochondrial cytoplasmic system.

the androgen treatment results in decreased 11β-oxidation of progesterone in the adrenal homogenates and this is associated with decreased cytochrome P 450 levels in the adrenal mitochondrion and with the binding of the androgens to the adrenal mitochondrions.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
androgen treatment of the rat results in a decrease in the 11β-hyroxylase activity of adrenal mitochondria.
androgens are bound to adrenal mitochondria where they inhibit the 11β-hydroylation reaction by lowering the levels of cytoplasmic P-450.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the androgens are able to interact with the adrenal mitochondrial electron transport chain and that this interaction is probably the cause of the observed inhibition of 11β-hydroylation in adrenal homogenate.
the androgens can interact with adrenal cytochrome P 450 and that this interaction may be important in the control of adrenal function.
